DESCRIPTION:
We don't just work at the materials / products and the lab-scale, we always consider processing routes when we're helping you to develop new products or improve existing ones.


At Lucideon, we can help you to optimize your processes to ensure yields are consistent, and that waste and failures are kept to a minimum.


Process optimization services include:


- Lab-scale testing of materials and products to ensure they are production-ready

- Development of a new manufacturing / processing line or making changes to an existing one

- Troubleshooting to determine what is causing issues during processing

- Raw material / component acceptance testing through spot audits or routine testing

- Validation of new material supplies and process changes to ensure specifications are met

- Scale-up of a technology from lab through to pilot and onto manufacturing scale.


We are currently working in the area of Additive Manufacturing (AM), helping manufacturers to improve processes, thereby reducing risk and improving process yield.

DESCRIPTION:
The Product release testing is important for the quality control (QC) of pharmaceuticals. Release testing for biotechnology or biopharmaceutical products addresses the criteria of purity, concentration, consistency, identity and biosafety.

Why Choosing Creative BioMart Pharmaceutical Product Testing?

Creative BioMart is an approved and accredited QC testing laboratory with a long history of pharmaceutical release testing. We bring years of experience and expertise performing all types of analytical testing on many drug substances and drug products to our release testing services. We provide the highest level of quality and attention to detail to our clients under strict cGMP compliance to assure that their QC testing of pharmaceuticals will be successfully executed.

You need a partner that can provide you with regulatory compliant release testing in a turnaround time that shortens the period from product manufacture to availability to the patient.

 

Analytical Technologies:
LC/MS/MS, HPLC (UV, PDA, FLU, ELSD, RI), UPLC (TUV, PDA, SQD), ACQUITY UPLC H-Class, GC, GPC, SEC, KF, TOC, Maldi-Tof, APSD (NGI, ACI) and etc.
Testing Range:
Capsules (IR/SR), Contact Lenses, Implantables, Injectables, Inhalers, Ocular Implants, Liquids, Patches, Suppositories, Suspensions, Synthetic, Blood, Tablets (IR/SR) and etc.
We guarantee you with:
1、Complete compendial analysis (BP, EP, JP and USP)；
2、API, IMP, FP Batch Release Testing and Lot Release Testing for small molecules, inhaled products and biopharmaceuticals.

Your pharmaceutical custom manufacturing project’s success is our priority. We’re focused on delivering superior results, every time. Enhanced by our uncompromising commitment to cGMP standards and proven compliance track record, we’re an expert partner you can trust.

With a focus on quality, innovation and flexibility, we offer manufacturing excellence across our global network. Our extensive manufacturing capabilities allow us to take your project from development to scale-up and commercial production.

Drug product custom manufacturing capabilities

Our drug product manufacturing capabilities cover a wide variety of drug product manufacturing and packaging technologies in many dosage forms. We specialize in solid dosage forms, liquid, gel, cream and ointment products, sterile gel, and finished goods packaging.

- Compressed tablets
- Micro and mini tablets

- Aqueous film coated tablets
- Capsules
- Controlled release beads
- Powders
- Liquids
- Creams
- Ointments
- Sterile
- Semi-solids
- Suppositories

Solid dose capabilities:

- Drying
- Lubrication
- Compression
- Encapsulation

- Oral suspensions

- Aqueous and solvent based premixes
- Topical gels of low to medium viscosity
- Product heating and cooling

- All compounding is carried out in a class C area
- Ability to add sterile API via an aseptic transfer vessel using glove ports
- Gamma irradiated sterile components transferred via aseptic processes through transfer docks into filling area
- Components are filled under Class A conditions

DESCRIPTION:
Raw material testing is a vital step to ensure that your supplier is meeting your specifications and gives you insight into the nature of your raw materials.  SGS provides testing that will verify the 
•	Identity
•	Safety 
•	Suitability for your product
Ultimately, our aim is to give you confidence that you are producing a safe, high quality product that meets the expectations of customers and regulatory bodies. 
Our network of laboratories offers comprehensive testing services according to the most recent pharmacopeia (USP/NF, JP, EP, BP, FCC, and ACS) under cGMP conditions. From method transfers of vendor methods, to developing and validating a custom method for your product, when you work with SGS, you have a partner with a strong history of delivering to a consistently high standard. 

•	SGS performs most USP/NF, JP, EP, BP, FCC, and ACS compendia methods complete with method verifications. SGS can also test custom materials using general chapters after compendia verifications. 

•	Our SGS labs will transfer in-house methods from your lab or CMO for your release testing needs. SGS has many years experience working with hundreds of vendors and suppliers. 

•	Our SGS labs are also well equipped with the latest instrumentation to perform customized method development and validations for your raw materials and excipients.    

•	SGS can ensure purity of raw materials by performing assays by HPLC, UPLC, GC and titrations.  

•	Identity confirmation by IR, UV, and colorimetric techniques are common in all SGS labs.

•	SGS also provides a variety of contamination testing such as residual solvent testing by GC and IC, and heavy metals testing by ICP-OES, ICP-MS, and AAS. 

Sub-Services:
•	Analytical Chemistry – SGS can provide method transfers, method development and validation, as well as compendia verification of existing methods for new products and uses.

•	Container Testing – SGS can test all your containers for physiochemical properties as well as moisture permeation and extractables and leachables testing.  We have extensive experience with glass and plastic bottles, materials for blister packs and pouches, and much more.

•	Elemental Analysis – SGS can perform CHN analysis on all materials, as well as ICP for heavy metals and IC for ion analysis. 

•	Karl Fisher Analysis – SGS can perform both volumetric titration method and the coulometric titration method.  Our labs can also test for water content by LOD as well. 
.
•	Microbiology – SGS is versed in multiple microbiological techniques that can ensure the purity and safety of raw materials reducing the risk of contamination issues with final products.

•	Residual Solvent Analysis - SGS can perform analytical testing for a wide variety of organic solvents to ensure that raw materials meet FDA and EP requirements for safe levels.  

•	Spectrophotometric Analysis – SGS offers many methods to analyze raw materials including IR, UV/Vis, AAS, and ICP. 

•	Sterility Testing – Sterility testing is vital for any products which will be marketed as “Sterile”. SGS is proficient in both membrane filtration and direct injection techniques. 

•	Thermodynamic Property Analysis – SGS analyzes raw materials for a variety of properties using techniques such as DSC, TGA and melting point.
 
•	Water Testing – SGS offers a wide variety of water testing ranging from Ultra-purified-DI water to potable drinking water, all used as raw materials.

- Levamisole, praziquantel, morantel, clorsulon, monepantel.

*Hormonal agents*

- Steroids
- Beta-agonists

*Poisons*

- Compound 1080 (fluoroacetate)
- Anticoagulants

*Other veterinary medicines*

- Non-steroidal anti-inflammatories (NSAIDs)
- Sedatives
- Thyreostats
